newsitem.title: FINLAND: HELSINKI TUMBLES ON NOKIA, NO HELP FROM H1 RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: HELSINKI TUMBLES ON NOKIA, NO HELP FROM H1 RESULTS.

text.p: * Shares clearly lower by noon with Nokia down to trade a shade above its Wall Street close, and H1 reports fail to cheer market, brokers say. Tone cautious and market seen flat awaiting U.S data on Wednesday, UPM's H1 report on Thursday.
* Merita flat after attempting gains on its H1 result, UPM 2.90 markka lower at 140.50, knocked by Dow's decline, Enso 0.50 markka lower at 51.00 after in-line H1. Neste eases.

Shares traded clearly lower in modest midsession trade as Nokia fell to trade just above its U.S. close and little fuel could be squeezed from Enso's and Merita's H1 results reported earlier, brokers said.
"This seems like a slack day as results only helped at the start," one broker said.
Brokers saw the indices remaining at current levels or ticking slightly lower as investors cautiously waited for U.S. retail sales and PPI data in the afternoon at 1530/1230 GMT.
Merita was flat although its first half earnings beat the highest forecast by a whisker.
"There must have been sellers who just wanted to see the result and then sell," one said.
The forest industry sub index was clearly down as UPM fell after Tuesday's rally on a decline in U.S. stocks overnight, down 1.40 markka at 142.00.
Enso fell 0.50 to 51.00 after reporting in-line H1 results earlier and some brokers the sector may have been overprised in the recent rally.
Focus turned to UPM's H1 results due on Thursday.
